name: Euclidean Distance Voxel SDF
definition: A method to compute a proper signed distance field for a voxel grid by calculating the exact Euclidean distance to the nearest occupied voxel (for outside points) or empty voxel (for inside points).
summary: Euclidean Distance Voxel SDF computes exact signed distances to surface boundaries for high-quality ray marching, differing from binary voxelization by providing continuous gradients at high computational cost.
